backend/main.mo: Defines core backend actor with access control and storage mixins plus all user, ritual, pairing, quiz, challenge, and analytics types.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to modified frontend files and components with metadata for QA validation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides predefined short summaries for various frontend files to support build planning and documentation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styling defining OKLCH color variables, themes, and base layout rules for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring viewport, theme color, metadata, and mounting the React application.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist detailing authentication, pairing, rituals, loading states, and overall UX polish test steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, profile setup, tab navigation, loading flows, and global query configuration.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a bottom navigation bar with tab buttons and icons, highlighting the active tab and handling tab changes.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays floating animated heart icons using randomized positions and delays for a completion effect.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable loading, empty, error, section header, and inline loading components for UI states.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows current harmony score, a 7‑day trend sparkline, and optional explanations based on backend trend data.
Displays a compact harmony summary button with percent and trend, linking to full insights.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles login/logout with Internet Identity, showing loading states and clearing cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Placeholder card announcing upcoming love challenges with decorative icons.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Card showing love languages status with a primary action button and a shortcut to insights.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Profile setup form collecting the user’s name, handling submission, errors, and success transition.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: UI component rendering heart‑themed progress visuals and milestone indicators using placeholder progress values.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel that selects a love language, with animation logic, easing, and daily spin persistence.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays unlockable activity packs tied to love languages, gated by streak requirements and selectable by the user.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity, auto‑refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and state tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin status, pairing, and ritual‑related backend data.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, custom OKLCH color themes for light/dark mode, typography, and several animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Renders the Activities page with authentication checks, admin overrides, visual effects, and components like LoveChallenges, RewardVisuals, and SpinWheel.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Implements the Home page with daily rituals, photo uploads, history display, completion animations, and love language theming.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Displays insights such as streaks, harmony metrics, badges, and quiz-based analytics with admin and pairing checks.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Provides the love languages quiz, including UI-to-backend mapping, question handling, scoring, and saving or resetting results.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Renders the Memories page, mapping ritual entries into expandable cards with love-language metadata, prompts, and user responses. Includes helpers for date formatting and love-language display.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Implements the Us page for pairing, profile checks, and partner-related state, including code generation, completion, and post-pairing highlights. Coordinates multiple queries and user actions with toasts and UI state.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helper functions for harmony percentage conversion, trend normalization, trend labeling, and display metadata. Ensures consistent 7-day series processing and UI mapping.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across hash and search routing. Supports session-backed parameter storage and selective hash cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and container settings for the project. Integrates plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s schema, features, and current system state including authentication, pairing, rituals, and insights. Serves as a high-level specification for existing capabilities.
